normal.text: …and the wheels aren’t actually doing anything, they’re just decorative. It also makes the back of the kart to stick out in the opposite direction of the turn, meaning the back of your kart can hit an obstacle to your right if you turn left… And that’s a problem! Turning to the left shouldn’t cause you to hit an object on your right! I’m sure I can get used to it, so I’m going to keep playing. Still, at least I know why the game feels so weird now. #mariokart #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: Computer Chronicles Revisited
normal.text: With all the TGA chatter, let’s look back 40 years to the first Software Publishers Association “Excellence in Software” Awards. The SPA equivalent of GOTY in 1986 was “Best Entertainment Product,” which went to ICOM Simulations’ “Déjà Vu,” a Mac point-and-click adventure published by Mindscape. “Déjà Vu” beat out “Hacker” (Activision), “Ultima IV” (Origin Systems), “King’s Quest II” (Sierra On-Line), “Airborne” (Silicon Beach), and “NFL Challenge” (Xor Corporation). #apple #retrogaming
